quote: There is no religion without love, and people may talk as much as they like about their religion, but if it does not teach them to be good and kind to man and beast it is all a sham.
source: Anna Sewell, Black Beauty, Part I, chapter 13 (John Manly)
speaker: John Manly
note: Sewell’s sentence runs on: all a sham, James, and it won’t stand when things come to be turned inside out. The line is cut at the clause and given a full stop; every word before the cut is hers, spoken by John Manly to James in chapter 13, The Devil’s Trade Mark.
